description.value: The Sandman Hotel Penticton is a mid-scale chain hotel on Burnaby Avenue offering a full suite of amenities including an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an unusual indoor pickleball court. The property has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting a genuine sustainability program including an EcoFund contribution per guest night. An on-site Denny's restaurant operates around the clock, making it a convenient base for cyclists arriving at variable hours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sandmanhotels.com/penticton is fully accessible and provides detailed room and amenity information, confirming an active, open hotel. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly listed across multiple pages; USB Charging Ports are confirmed in room features; and an on-site Denny's 24-Hour Restaurant is referenced in both amenity lists and room descriptions. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a functioning website and active bookings. Useful stop for touring cyclists despite absence of confirmed cycling-specific amenities.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Denny's 24-Hour Restaurant confirmed in amenity lists and room descriptions

Device charging.detail: USB Charging Ports listed as a room feature on the Standard Room, 1 King Bed subpage
